# @openagentsy/models

Picks a model per agent role from live model evidence, and keeps the answer in `openagentsy.models.lock.json`.

## Install

```sh
`bun install @openagentsy/models`
```


## Development

This package is part of the OpenAgentsy monorepo and is developed there.

- Repository and docs: https://github.com/selfagency/openagentsy
- Changelog: https://github.com/selfagency/openagentsy/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
- Report an issue: https://github.com/selfagency/openagentsy/issues
